messages:
Ada (Growth): Quick idea — build a 30m "rapid playbook" webinar that shows 3 production-first inference patterns + one live micro-demo. Goal: buyer-stage + PLG funnel. Need to capture speaker slots + a rehearsal window by EOD tomorrow.

Noah (Producer): Love it. Can we do 20m content + 8m live demo + 2m CTA? keeps it punchy.

Maria (Content): Proposed mini-topics: (1) cost-aware batching + results, (2) private deployment checklist for compliance, (3) routing + fallbacks for reliability. Which order feels highest impact?

Sam (Eng): Routing demo is easiest to rehearse (we can run a small canary in-prod sim). I can own the demo infra if scheduled after 9am PT.

Ezra (Partnerships): I'll bring a customer who can speak 3 mins on what Dedicated capacity bought them. If accepted, slot them in the second half.

Ada (Growth): OK — tentative order: 1) cost-aware batching (Maria + data), 2) Dedicated customer vignette (Ezra + customer), 3) routing & fallbacks (Sam), live micro-demo.

Noah (Producer): Rehearsal asks: everyone must be on greenroom 45m before start. Tech check for live demo: test tokens, model pinned to `v1.3-dedicated`, fallback route configured. I'll post run-of-show in 10.

rehearsals-bot: Reminder scheduled: Rehearsal slot reserved 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. Join link: https://meet.redwood/rehearsal-1777772024

Maria (Content): Draft abstract for landing page: "Production-First Inference: Practical levers that cut cost and keep latency predictable" — includes 3 small playbooks + live demo. I'll drop 2 variants in the drive.

Ada (Growth): Nice. CTA options: 1) Try a bench run (free credits) 2) Request a Dedicated eval 3) Join customer Q&A. Which do we lead with?

Ezra (Partnerships): Lead with Dedicated eval for enterprise ops, but include bench run as the low-friction CTA in the footer.

Sam (Eng): For the demo, small checklist:
```
- model: `redwood/opt-quant-8bit:v2`
- sequence: 256 tokens
- route fallback: `redwood/llama-compat-lowprio`
- pre-warm cache: prefix "demo_prompt"
- telemetry: enable trace=true
```
I'll paste exact commands into the rehearsal doc.

Noah (Producer): Run-of-show (draft): 00:00 intro & agenda (Ada) — 03:00 playbook 1 (Maria) — 11:00 customer vignette (Ezra + guest) — 16:00 playbook 2 routing (Sam) — 24:00 live micro-demo & Q&A — 30:00 CTA + wrap. Keep Qs via chat only, moderate live.

Maria (Content): I'll create 2 subject lines and 3 social blurbs. Also prepping 5 evaluation prompts for quality checks post-demo.

Ada (Growth): Assignments: Maria — abstracts + emails by EOD; Sam — demo infra + test run by EOD; Ezra — confirm customer + 1 slide; Noah — greenroom invite + run-of-show final. Everyone reacts with :thumbsup: when committed.

Sam (Eng): :thumbsup: will run test at 9:30 PT tomorrow.

Ezra (Partnerships): :thumbsup: customer confirmed, short slide incoming.

Maria (Content): :thumbsup: drafts in drive: https://drive.redwood/marketing/rapid-playbook-drafts

Ada (Growth): Great — locking rehearsal 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. If anything changes tag me. Small ask: keep demo fallback enabled otherwise we'll lose attendees if live model hiccups.

Noah (Producer): Noted — adding fallback policy and post-demo latch to runbook. Will ping infra on the day.

Ada (Growth): Thanks team — excited. I'll follow up with the landing page copy after I see Maria's variants.
